summary: #edu407 Yes requirement for all teachers to show student growth has taken an assessment, already fraught with reliability issues, and compounded it with explicit and implicit teacher bias. Teachers know they must show growth and may adjust how hard they measure or what they teach
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: #edu407 Yes requirement for all teachers to show student growth has taken an assessment, already fraught with reliability issues, and compounded it with explicit and implicit teacher bias. Teachers know they must show growth and may adjust how hard they measure or what they teach
